_comment: Scenarios that do not yet pass, keyed by test name, with why. 'migrations'
and 'equivalences' apply on every topology; 'topologies' adds gaps for one
pair of servers, named as the suite names it (pg17→pg15).
The suite fails on any failure not listed here, and on a listed one that
starts passing, so the list can only shrink.

migrations.objects_in_quoted_schema (before → after: DBDiff compares the public schema only.
migrations.objects_in_quoted_schema (after → before: DBDiff compares the public schema only.
migrations.objects_in_another_schema (before → afte: DBDiff compares the public schema only.
migrations.objects_in_another_schema (after → befor: DBDiff compares the public schema only.
migrations.partitions_added_with_default_and_index: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 creates a partitioned table's index ON ONLY, so it never reaches the partitions. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
migrations.sequence_shared_and_owned_with_options (: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 treats a sequence owned by a column as its serial, losing its options. Fixed in DBDiff#245.

data.text_escaping: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 quotes data values MySQL's way, so a quote or backslash breaks the INSERT on PostgreSQL. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
data.json_values: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 quotes data values MySQL's way, so a JSON value with a quote fails to apply. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
data.array_values: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 quotes data values MySQL's way, so an array literal with quotes is malformed. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
data.binary_values: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 cannot read bytea, which PDO returns as a stream. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
data.no_primary_key: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 skips a table with no primary key. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
data.identity_always: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 inserts into a GENERATED ALWAYS identity without OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE. Fixed in DBDiff#245.
data.generated_column: @dbdiff/cli rc.18 writes generated columns. Fixed in DBDiff#245.

migrations.enum_label_removed_under_readers (before: PostgreSQL 15 renders a view's columns table-qualified (o.id) and 16+ does not, so every view reads as changed between the two: DBDiff recreates it and the state comparison reports its definition.
